case_for: Went to the customer first: specific pilot sites and what broke, volunteered unprompted (R2, R1).

case_against: Pilot-to-rollout conversion unproven; no pilot numbers in the file (R3).
Long enterprise sales cycles and a CEO still learning procurement (R4).

Co-investor-led early round - the fund may not lead (S2).
call_questions: For each pilot site: throughput vs target, uptime, and whether it has converted to a paid rollout.
What is hardware gross margin per unit today, and at 50 units?
How long from first meeting to signed PO with an enterprise customer so far?
Who leads the round and what is our role in it?
Tell us about the pilot that went worst - what did the customer say, and would they buy today?
what_would_change_our_view: At least one pilot converted to a paid multi-unit rollout with hardware margin data, and a round the fund can lead or co-lead.
